Dialogue-only owner transcript entry. Constructed by allowlist only —
never by stripping fields from a raw DB/engine row.

anyOf.description: Versioned viewer-safe dialogue context stored on modern transcript rows.

sessionAudiencePlayerIds.description: Session-time membership snapshot for huddles (IDs only).

formalSpeechCorrelationKey.description:
Deterministic formal-speech correlation key shared with accepted public
speech events. Enables U6 parity without fuzzy text matching. Optional so
ordinary dialogue and legacy rows remain valid. Not part of product-dialogue
digest identity (CanonicalDialogueContextV2 omits it).

formatRecap.description:
Canonical per-round format evidence. Absent from older cached reads and
classic/endgame-only rounds.

power.description:
Classic Power path only.
Omitted on format-kernel rounds (absence means not in kernel, not unresolved).

council.description:
Classic Council path only.
Omitted on format-kernel rounds (absence means not in kernel, not unresolved).

endgame.description: Endgame stage facts when this round has Reckoning/Tribunal/Judgment activity.

exposeTarget.description:
Legacy dual-ballot expose target.
Omitted entirely on format-kernel empower-only ledgers (do not emit null noise).

RevealedFormatFacts.description: Public format facts for format-kernel rounds.

restrictedHistory.description: Added with Restricted History; absent only from older serialized fixtures.

twoNames.description: Added with Two Names; absent only from older serialized fixtures.

acceptedBallots.description: Sanitized accepted ballots in canonical event order, readable immediately by operators.

ballotPresentation.description: Resolution-gated, canonical roster-ordered presentation roll call.

polarity.description: Present for Save-or-Exit; null for The Short List / Safety Bounce final votes.

RevealedEndgameFacts.description:
First-class endgame stage facts for Reckoning / Tribunal / Judgment.
Present only when the round has endgame or jury activity.

progression.description: Next stage id when known from a later stage_set, else winner when Judgment resolved.

WerewolfRole.description: Werewolf owns its rules and event vocabulary; Influence phases do not apply.
